epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false-positive project stagnation warnings from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: Fix deliverable readiness calculation to correctly evaluate queued tasks and clear the stagnation warning

slices.title: Patch deliverable readiness stagnation calculation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the readiness calculation fix for this epic, I want to patch the static deliverable state evaluation, so that true progress is tracked and the stagnation warning is resolved
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task stuck for >4h that should not block progress
When the deliverable readiness is calculated
Then the calculation correctly counts the task and clears the stagnation warning
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unresolved task state evaluation errors from 1 to 0

slices.title: QA for deliverable readiness bugfix
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to verify the readiness calculation patch, so that the stagnation warning resolution is verified end-to-end
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a test environment with simulated perpetually queued tasks
When the project observer metric is queried
Then tests confirm the stagnation warning is correctly resolved and readiness is updated
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage for deliverable readiness stagnation edge cases from 0 to 1
